name: Arrears Wraith
languages: the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Phobia
Traits.text: While the arrears wraith can see a coin-bearing creature within 30 feet of itself, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it must use its movement on each of its turns to move away from a coin-bearing creature by the safest available route unless there is nowhere farther to go.
Traits.gmQuote: a tax ghost that makes you drop what you are carrying
Traits.expresses: makes prey drop what they carry

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The arrears wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the arrears wraith has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The arrears wraith makes two Ledger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Regard of the Hollow Debt.

Actions.name: Ledger
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (4d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Regard of the Hollow Debt
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage.

lore: A tax-collector who died with his own arrears unpaid and his ledger still open drifts back into counting-houses and toll-roads, forever demanding from the living what he could never square with the dead.
